name: secretsmanager
description: Amazon Web Services Secrets Manager Amazon Web Services Secrets Manager provides a service to enable you to store, manage, and retrieve, secrets.

subcommands.name: batch-get-secret-value
subcommands.description: Retrieves the contents of the encrypted fields SecretString or SecretBinary for up to 20 secrets.

subcommands.name: cancel-rotate-secret
subcommands.description: Turns off automatic rotation, and if a rotation is currently in progress, cancels the rotation.

subcommands.name: create-secret
subcommands.description: Creates a new secret.

subcommands.name: delete-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the resource-based permission policy attached to the secret.

subcommands.name: delete-secret
subcommands.description: Deletes a secret and all of its versions.

subcommands.name: describe-secret
subcommands.description: Retrieves the details of a secret.

subcommands.name: get-random-password
subcommands.description: Generates a random password.

subcommands.name: get-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Retrieves the JSON text of the resource-based policy document attached to the secret.

subcommands.name: get-secret-value
subcommands.description: Retrieves the contents of the encrypted fields SecretString or SecretBinary from the specified version of a secret, whichever contains content.

subcommands.name: list-secret-version-ids
subcommands.description: Lists the versions of a secret.

subcommands.name: list-secrets
subcommands.description: Lists the secrets that are stored by Secrets Manager in the Amazon Web Services account, not including secrets that are marked for deletion.

subcommands.name: put-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Attaches a resource-based permission policy to a secret.

subcommands.name: put-secret-value
subcommands.description: Creates a new version of your secret by creating a new encrypted value and attaching it to the secret.

subcommands.name: remove-regions-from-replication
subcommands.description: For a secret that is replicated to other Regions, deletes the secret replicas from the Regions you specify.

subcommands.name: replicate-secret-to-regions
subcommands.description: Replicates the secret to a new Regions.

subcommands.name: restore-secret
subcommands.description: Cancels the scheduled deletion of a secret by removing the DeletedDate time stamp.

subcommands.name: rotate-secret
subcommands.description: Configures and starts the asynchronous process of rotating the secret.

subcommands.name: stop-replication-to-replica
subcommands.description: Removes the link between the replica secret and the primary secret and promotes the replica to a primary secret in the replica Region.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Attaches tags to a secret.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes specific tags from a secret.

subcommands.name: update-secret
subcommands.description: Modifies the details of a secret, including metadata and the secret value.

subcommands.name: update-secret-version-stage
subcommands.description: Modifies the staging labels attached to a version of a secret.

subcommands.name: validate-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Validates that a resource policy does not grant a wide range of principals access to your secret.
